svg.title: CH-TG trigger simulator

text.tspan: CH-TG: CDI trigger simulator with isolated measurement bus · schematic (PROPOSED, Phase 3)

Pulse = CD4052B analog mux switching between V_AMP+, V_AMP− and GND (amplitude set by DACs, verified by an ADS1115 on an isolated I²C segment). Everything on the left lives in the 12 V power domain; the Pico only reaches it through isolators.

svg.text: 12 V POWER DOMAIN (ground = GND_P) · live only when armed, except the always-on parts marked 3V3_P

text.tspan: Always on (from 12V_RAW): the isolator, the ADS1115 and the DACs
work before arming, so the firmware can check the power side
U13: 10 µF on CAP+/CAP−, 10 µF out.
U12 = 78L05 (default). A 78L09 gives the ±9 V option (JP1).
U18 TL072: V+ = 12V_ARMED, V− = −5V_P (swing about +10 V / −3.5 V). The buses are stiff
DC levels. The mux connects them to the output only for the pulse width.
11 = X3 = GND: idle, and the default when the
INH pulled to 12 V = all switches open (default).
Y section unused: all its pins to GND_P.
CDI POWER + comes from J3 (12V_ARMED, 2 A fuse). The CDI IGNITION wire goes
straight to the coil primary, not to this board. Idle: OUT sits at 0 V through the
selected source resistor, like a pickup coil at rest.
Isolated I²C segment: SDA_P / SCL_P with 4.7 kΩ pull-ups to 3V3_P.
On the logic side, the main bus continues to the ADS1115 (0x48) and the MCP23017s.
• Pulse width, rate and order come from the Pico (GP6 / GP7, PIO or PWM). Positive pulse: A on. Negative: B on. Biphasic: A then B. The edges take 20–40 µs
(PC817 + 4.7 kΩ), plenty for pickup-like pulses of 0.2–10 ms.
• Amplitude: V_AMP+ 0 … 9.9 V, V_AMP− 0 … −3.3 V. Set by the DACs, then read back on U15. To check the real OUT level under load, hold a long pulse (100 ms)
with the CDI disconnected, read V_OUT_M, and compare with the bus levels.
• Self-test before arming: the 3V3_P side works (isolator, ADS1115, DACs answer). After arming: check the rails, the buses and OUT before the CDI is connected.
• The unknown-CDI search steps V_AMP+ up from the lowest level until the CDI fires, then records the threshold.
⚠ Fire the CDI only into a load
Ignition coil and spark gap in a closed non-conductive box,
30 cm from the Pico and laptop. Arm only after the wiring
is done. This board carries no HV, the CDI makes it.
